guidelines.fragment_description: Represents a user or another system that interacts with the subject (system) in the use case diagram.
Represents a distinct functionality or interaction scenario in the system.
Defines the interaction between an actor and a use case in the use case diagram.
Defines an optional extension of a use case's functionality by another use case.
Indicates that a use case includes the behavior of another use case.
Encapsulates use cases, representing the boundary of the system.
